verses.text: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
lines: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel,
you who lead Joseph like a flock,
you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

verses.text: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
lines: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might!
Come to save us!

verses.text: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
lines: Turn us again, God.
Cause your face to shine,
and we will be saved.

verses.text: Yahweh God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
lines: Yahweh God of Armies,
how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

verses.text: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
lines: You have fed them with the bread of tears,
and given them tears to drink in large measure.

verses.text: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
lines: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors.
Our enemies laugh among themselves.

verses.text: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
lines: Turn us again, God of Armies.
Cause your face to shine,
and we will be saved.

verses.text: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
lines: You brought a vine out of Egypt.
You drove out the nations, and planted it.

verses.text: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
lines: You cleared the ground for it.
It took deep root, and filled the land.

verses.text: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
lines: The mountains were covered with its shadow.
Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

verses.text: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.
lines: It sent out its branches to the sea,
its shoots to the River.

verses.text: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
lines: Why have you broken down its walls,
so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

verses.text: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
lines: The boar out of the wood ravages it.
The wild animals of the field feed on it.

verses.text: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
lines: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies.
Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

verses.text: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
lines: the stock which your right hand planted,
the branch that you made strong for yourself.

verses.text: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
lines: It’s burned with fire.
It’s cut down.
They perish at your rebuke.

verses.text: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
lines: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand,
on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

verses.text: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
lines: So we will not turn away from you.
Revive us, and we will call on your name.

verses.text: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
lines: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies.
Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
